data.name: Butcher hero: hook'n'chew RPG
data.detailed_description:
Enter Butcher, a brutal RPG survival game where a butcher fights every monster and alien to dominate pure survival. This dark role playing game throws you into nonstop combat where every kill fuels your upgrade and pushes your RPG build further. In this relentless survival world, the butcher grows stronger with each monster consumed and each alien defeated.

Butcher Hook

Hook every monster, drag every alien, and turn combat into power. Each enemy gives a permanent upgrade, making this RPG survival system endless. Different boss and alien types unlock unique upgrade paths so your butcher evolves beyond limits.

Role Playing Game Evolution

This is not just survival — it’s deep RPG growth. Absorb stats from every monster. Stack damage, speed, or armor through constant upgrade choices. Prepare for brutal boss fights where only the strongest butcher survives.

Infinite Power

Grow from weak butcher to unstoppable titan. Smash through waves of monster enemies and towering boss threats. Every upgrade makes your RPG survival build stronger against every alien and boss.

How long can your survival last? In this role playing game, every boss, monster, and alien makes your butcher stronger.
